confidence_notes: Orlando price indexes informed the July meal, coffee and beer estimates. [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Orlando) [Restaurant price index](https://www.averagecostof.living/in/united-states/orlando/restaurants/) The cocktail uses a local menu median. Wine was estimated relative to draft beer and checked against by-the-glass prices. [Cocktail menus](https://searchthemenu.com/florida/orlando/cocktails/) [Wine menus](https://searchthemenu.com/florida/orlando/wine/) Lodging is modeled, with both hostel rates especially uncertain because supply is limited. Prices exclude taxes, tips and lodging fees.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lodging estimates reflect July family travel demand and the supply of off-site budget and mid-range hotels in the Orlando–Kissimmee area.
